{{Infobox_character|name = ''Age of Extinction''
Drift|Faction = Autobot|Origin = Cinematic|Class = [[Warrior]]|image = Drift featured.png|Release Date = June 15, 2017}} ==Bio== ''Though some may question Drift’s loyalty to the Autobots, there’s no denying his dedication to his “sensei” Optimus Prime. Forged to wield his powerful swords, this samurai of a bot is all business when it’s time to swing or fling his blades.'' ==Max Stats== '''2-Star''' *Health: 1,732 *Attack: 152 *Max Rating: 546 '''3-Star''' *Health: 4,253 *Attack: 325 *Max Rating: 1,307 '''4-Star''' *Health: 11,053 *Attack: 843 *Max Rating: 3,476 5-Star {| class="article-table" !Rank/Level !Health !Attack !Rating !Sig/forge |- |1/1 |5,940 |453 |1,404 | |- |1/10 |9,369 |715 |2,345 |5 |- |2/20 |12,440 |950 |3,168 |5/18 |- |3/30 |16,183 |1,235 |4,375 |20/18 |- |4/40 |21,035 |1,605 |5,867 |20/18 |- |5/50 |26,833 |2,046 |8,420 |99 |} ==Game Abilities== ===Basic Abilities=== * Precision * Critical Damage * Bleed ===Abilities=== '''Combo Meter ''' * At 5 hits Drift gains his Focus and gains a Precision Buff that increases Crit Chance by 20~30% and decreases the opponent’s chance to Evade (by 75~85%) until hit next by the opponent. * At 10 hits Drift’s Focus improves and grants him a 20~40% Crit Damage Buff in addition to his Precision Buff until hit next by the opponent. '''Critical Sword Attacks''' * 61% chance to cause a Bleed for 15~25% of Attack over 2 seconds. '''On Bleeding Opponents''' * 10% chance to Evade attacks from Bleeding opponents. * Drift becomes 5% more evasive for each active Focus Buff. '''Heavy Attacks''' * Drift has a 100% chance to regain his focus Precision Buff. {| class="article-table" !Rank !Precision !Crit Damage !Bleed Chance/Damage |- |1 |20% |20% |60%, 15% |- |2 |22% |25% |61%, 18% |- |3 |25% |30% |62%, 20% |- |4 |27% |35% |63%, 22% |- |5 |30% |40% |64%, 25% |- |6 |35% |45% |65%, 30% |} ===Signature Ability=== '''Deep focus''' ''The ancient martial art of Diffusion has one final level to attain.'' * At 15 hits Drift achieves full focus and gains a Deep Focus Buff that increases the duration of his bleeds by 50~150% until hit next by the opponent. * + about 1.02% per level. {| class="article-table" !Level !Duration |- |1 |50% |- |5 |54.1% |- |10 |59.1% |- |15 |64.2% |- |20 |69.2% |- |25 |74.2% |- |30 |79.3% |- |35 |84.3% |- |40 |89.4% |- |45 |94.4% |- |50 |99.5% |- |55 |104.5% |- |60 |109.6% |- |65 |114.6% |- |70 |119.7% |- |75 |124.8% |- |80 |129.8% |- |85 |134.8% |- |90 |139.9% |- |95 |145% |- |99 |149% |- |100 |150% |} ===Special Attacks=== # '''Courage''' - ''The heat of battle…'' #*80% chance to cause up to 2 bleeds to the opponent inflicting 20~40% of attack over 3 seconds. # '''Discipline''' - ''…a flurry of ancient swords…'' #*100% chance to inflict an epic Bleed on opponents for 100% of Attack over 10 seconds. # '''Respect''' - ''…enemies conquered.'' #*80% chance to cause up to 2 bleeds to the opponent inflicting 20~40% of attack over 3 seconds. Additionally 80~100% chance to inflict an epic Bleed on opponents for 50~100% of Attack over 10(s). {| class="article-table" !Rank !S1 Bleed Chance/Damage !Epic Bleed Damage (Sp2 & 3) !S3 Bleed Chance/Damage |- |1 |72%, 22% |75% |50%, 15% |- |2 |74%, 27% |90% |52%, 18% |- |3 |76%, 30% |100% |54%, 20% |- |4 |78%, 33% |110% |56%, 22% |- |5 |80%, 37% |125% |58%, 25% |- |6 |85%, 45% |150% |60%, 30% |} ===Synergy Bonuses=== *[[File:Synergy-incoming.jpg]][[File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Sensei/Allies''' – [[Optimus Prime (MV1)|'''Optimus Prime (MV1)''']]''', Hound''' - +2~10% Armor. *[[File:Synergy-incoming.jpg]][[File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Enemies - [[Mixmaster]]''' - +2~3~8% Attack Rating. *[[File:Synergy-incoming.jpg]][[File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Swordmasters - [[Windblade]], [[Bludgeon]], [[Dinobot]]''' - +2~4~10% Critical Damage for each Sword Attack that isn't a Critical Hit until the next Critical Hit. +4~8~12% more Critical Hits in Solo Missions. *[[File:Synergy-incoming.jpg]] '''Medic Support''' - [[Hound|'''Hound''']] - 1.3~2.5~7% of base Health Repaired at the start of the fight. +3~4~5% extra Repair in Raids. *[[File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Leadership''' (5-Star) - Lower tier teammate +10% Critical Damage. ==Strategy== ==='''Commander'''=== Once Drift has achieved focus from 5 hits or a heavy his sword strikes are very good at hitting Evasive bots with little chance of them escaping. His bleeds also enable himself to Evade, so work your finesse to get full 3-tier focus for the longest bleeds. ==='''Opponent'''=== Drift’s powerful melee playstyles has a weakness against Ranged Attacks, As such he is rather easy to fight. Like an Al Ratchet, an Al Drift can spam the annoying heavy attacks to build up his combos. Never take any of his bleeds or he will constantly evade your attacks though precision buffs or deceleration debuffs can stop him from evading, ===Strong Match-ups=== * Drift’s Precision Buff will ensure that [[Scout|scouts]]''' '''has nowhere to Evade to.'''''' *[[Megatron (ROTF)]] - More bleeds and Critical Hits will bypass Megatron's ''''''tough armor. * '''[[Wheeljack]]''' - Drift's frequent Critical Melee Hits will throw a wrench in Wheeljack's plans. ===Weak Match-ups=== *'''Anyone with unstoppable buffs''' like [[Motormaster]] will break through Drift’s combos. *(MV1) [[Optimus Prime (MV1)|Optimus Prime's]] ability to Repair while Bleeding will turn one of Drift’s greatest strengths against himself. *[[Optimus Primal]] is a bot to never challenge with Drift. Your combo buffs will do nothing and bleeding the robotic ape will only repair him. Never challenge the king of the jungle with Drift. *[[Grimlock]] should also never be messed with. The king of the Dinobots will turn Drift's bleed strength against him with sheer strength. * '''[[Hot Rod]], [[Arcee]], [[Hound]] and [[Waspinator]]''' can disable Drift's Evades on Bleeding Opponents (which is a thing especially when he's on a Harm Accelerator). *'''[[Kickback]]''' will T-Clog Drift from using his heavy attacks to build combos despite the class type advantages. * '''[[Thundercracker]]''' can purify Drift's many Bleeds and turn them into Melee Buffs. * '''[[Megatronus]]''' should also never be messed with since the bleeds will be weakened when the relic of preservation''' '''is active. Megatronus too doesn’t evade attacks and the relic of obedience will not allow Drift to have any other buffs. ===Recommended Modules=== *Drift Evades while the opponent is Bleeding; with the [[Harm Accelerator]], that time is always. *The [[Nightbird's Mark]] can help Drift deal more Critical Damage and Evade more Melee attacks. *The [[E.M.I. Module]] can give Drift more chances to Focus. Also, forcing enemies to fight him up close will fuel his Combo Meter. *[[Strange Refractor]] - for better Block Proficiency, allowing him to Protect his Combo Meter in Close Combat. ==Obtainment== * Drift Arenas * Samurai Crystal * Drift Raid Event * Bot Crystals * [[Calendar]] - [[Calendar#June 2019|June 2019]] * Swordmasters Bundle - contains 10 Samurai Crystals and 10 Warrior Tank Crystals for USD $20. * Drift's Signature Bundle - contains 3-Star Drift, 3-Star Warrior Awakening Program, 3-Star Warrior Signature Upgrade, and Gold for USD $20. * June 2020 Frontline Set ==Gallery== Drift.png Drift Icon.jpg Drift portrait.png Drift Icon v2.jpg Drift portrait v2.png Drift Chip.png|Drift Chip Samurai Crystal banner.jpg == Updates == * Critical sword hit Bleed chance used to rank-scale at 52~60%. * Special 2 Bleed chance used to rank-scale at 80~100%. == Trivia == * His vehicle mode is based on the 2013 Bugatti Veyron Grand Sport Vitesse, but modified to avoid licensing issues, most noticeably the grill. ==External Links== [[Category:Bots]] [[Category:Autobots]] [[Category:Cinematic]] [[Category:Cinematic Autobots]] [[Category:Warrior]] [[Category:5-Star Bots]] [[Category:Age Of Extinction]] [[Category:The Last Knight]] [[Category:AOE]] [[Category:TLK]] [[Category:1-Star Bots]] [[Category:2-Star Bots]] [[Category:3-Star Bots]] [[Category:4-Star Bots]]
